name: Community — MiniMax H3 (Regenerate 1080p)
author: NVIDIA (Open-H3-Regenerate-2K) + Kijai + LBH-123-AI
description: Regenerate a finished MiniMax H3 clip at 1080p with NVIDIA's Open-H3-Regenerate-2K refiner. Drop the clip in Reference Video 1 and paste the brief that made it. The clip is encoded, upscaled by LBH-123-AI's 3D latent upscaler, then re-rendered in three steps from NVIDIA's own schedule (sigma 0.909 to 0, CFG 1) with the refiner LoRA, Kijai's rank-384 extraction. That is far more new detail than the Video Refine pack: hair strands, knit, skin and readable lettering appear. Because it starts from 91% noise it regenerates rather than polishes, so the card feeds the source's first frame back in as an anchor; without it a close-up face came back as a different, older person on two seeds. The source soundtrack is muxed back untouched. First 5 s of the clip only.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Regenerate 1080p (Open-H3 refiner)
presets.tagline: Re-render an H3 clip at 1080p with new fine detail - source audio kept
presets.description: Drop a finished H3 clip (480p or 768p) in Reference Video 1 and paste the same brief that made it. Output is the clip's first 5 s regenerated at 1080p in three steps by NVIDIA's Open-H3-Regenerate-2K refiner, with the source's first frame as an identity anchor and the source soundtrack kept. Pick the aspect that matches your clip; the duration slider is ignored. Detail comes up a lot, most from 480p clips; the person stays the same but can pick up small changes such as added stubble or a lowered gaze opened up. Measured on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti: 5 s to 1920x1088 in about 7 min. It needs most of 32 GB of system RAM: close other apps, or it can take several times longer. Use the Video Refine pack when the clip must stay exactly as it is.

video.displayModel: MiniMax H3 FL2VA (pruned int8) + LBH 3D Latent Upscaler + NVIDIA Open-H3 Regenerate refiner (Kijai r384)

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed by SimpliGen.

extensions.name: Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
extensions.description: Trained 3D latent upscaler (MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D). Same pin as the Two-Stage and Video Refine packs.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ for SimpliGen's Faster Attention injection (supportsSage). Not used by the graph itself.

requirements.notes: Measured 2026-10-29 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti, SimpliGen engine, Sage on, Sol-Attn off, 5 s clips to 1920x1088: 864x480 source in 415 s, 1344x768 sources in 453-477 s, when nothing else held system RAM (with another ComfyUI holding models the same job took 15-46 min). Sharpness at native pixels (Laplacian variance) against the Video Refine graph run at the same size: about 3x on two faces in a 480p cafe shot, 1.3x on a 768p close-up face with 2x on the background, and only a small gain on a soft, dark profile shot. Identity held on all three clips and two seeds; expect small changes such as added stubble or a lowered gaze opened up. NVIDIA's plain recipe (no first frame) turned a close-up face into a different person on two seeds; the first-frame anchor holds it. NVIDIA's full mix (refiner + lightx2v Turbo + LMS Sharp) is sharper still but paged to 12-31 min on 31 GB RAM, so the card uses the refiner alone. Peak RAM use is high: close other apps; below ~2 GB free the decode can fail. The refiner is NVIDIA's (MiniMax H3 Community License); the file is Kijai's extraction of the refiner part only. Shares the FL2VA base with the I2V packs.
